_comment: Mock seed_set for SK-NEW-A basic_graph_traversal scenario. Three seeds: two are graph-resident (resolvable to n1 and n2 in graph.json via source_file = pdf_path), one is graph-stub (no pdf_path resolution). The graph-stub seed exercises the external fall-through branch of SK-NEW-A's iteration.

claim_register.claim_text: Snowballing achieves saturation within four iterations on a moderate seed set per Wohlin's protocol.
Empirical replication confirms the per-iteration admission rate halves between iteration 1 and iteration 2.
